entries.def: 臨床指引是一套照護建議，目的是讓病人得到最好的照護；建議依據有系統整理過的研究證據，並比較不同做法的好處與壞處。
entries.example: 例如2026年國際蕁麻疹指引，由59國、107個學會的代表參與制定。
entries.note: 建議有強弱之分；較弱（有條件）的建議，要依個人情況和醫師一起決定。
entries.label: IOM 2011・定義

evidence.quote: Clinical practice guidelines are statements that include recommendations intended to optimize patient care that are informed by systematic reviews of evidence and assessments of the benefits and harms of alternative care options.
evidence.location: Introduction (Institute of Medicine 2011 definition, quoted verbatim by the authors)
evidence.supports: def（指引＝為了最佳照護而提出的建議；依據系統性回顧的證據與不同做法的好壞比較）

evidence.quote: It is an initiative of the Global Allergy and Asthma Excellence Network (GALEN) and its Urticaria and Angioedema Centers of Reference and Excellence (UCAREs and ACAREs), with the participation of 210 delegates from 107 national and international societies, from 59 countries.
evidence.supports: example（國際指引：59國、107個學會的代表參與）

evidence.quote: According to GRADE, a recommendation is categorized as strong if the panel is very confident that the benefits of an intervention clearly outweigh the harms (or vice versa); a conditional recommendation denotes uncertainty regarding the balance of benefits and harms, such as when the evidence quality is low or very low, or when the decision is particularly sensitive to individual patient preferences, or when costs are expected to affect the decision.
Thus, conditional recommendations refer to decisions in which incorporation of patient preferences and values is an essential element of shared decision making.
evidence.supports: note（有條件建議要和醫師共同決定）

evidence.quote: A strong recommendation in favour of an intervention was made when the benefits clearly outweighed the risks, or vice versa (recommendation against), for nearly all people with SLE, or weak when risks and benefits were more closely balanced or where there was more uncertainty.
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes（核對網站「強烈建議／建議」說明）

entries.confidence: High (PMC full text; IOM definition quoted in a PubMed-indexed definitional paper, plus Tier-1 site-cited guidelines)
entries.reviewer_notes: IOM 2011 definition is taken as quoted (in quotation marks) in Morizane 2025 (PMC full text); the original IOM report is not PubMed-indexed and was not read, so its exact original wording (e.g. singular/plural of "systematic review(s)") was not checked. The site also calls EULAR/ASAS "recommendations" 指引; this fits the general IOM sense (recommendations informed by systematic review). Site legend check: 強烈建議／建議 wording is consistent with the GRADE definitions quoted from ACR 2022 (strong = benefits clearly outweigh harms; conditional = uncertain balance, preference-sensitive, shared decision making) and with BSR 2026 SLE ("strong ... for nearly all people with SLE, or weak when risks and benefits were more closely balanced or where there was more uncertainty"). Alias 指引 is very frequent on the site; consider linking only its first occurrence per page.

entries.def: 系統性回顧是針對一個清楚的問題，用明確、有系統的方法蒐集相關研究，再整理、綜合這些研究的結果。
entries.example: 例如一篇DHEA研究回顧搜尋了4個資料庫，找到乾燥症研究5項、共240名女性。
entries.note: 系統性回顧不一定會把數據合併計算；有合併計算的部分稱為統合分析。

evidence.quote: A review that uses explicit, systematic methods to collate and synthesise findings of studies that address a clearly formulated question
evidence.location: Box 1 Glossary of terms, entry "Systematic review" (the bold term label is dropped in the PMC extraction; label confirmed verbatim on bmj.com via WebFetch)

evidence.quote: PRISMA 2020 is intended for use in systematic reviews that include synthesis (such as pairwise meta-analysis or other statistical synthesis methods) or do not include synthesis (for example, because only one eligible study is identified).
evidence.location: The PRISMA 2020 statement – Scope of the guideline
evidence.supports: note（系統性回顧可有或沒有合併計算）

evidence.quote: This article proceeded an extensive systematic search of articles published in the following four databases: PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, Scopus, and Scielo from 1966 to April 2023
evidence.location: Methods – Literature review (grammar as in original)

evidence.quote: In SS, the five studies encompassed 240 individuals, all females, and showed modest results.
The results were synthesised in two tables and no meta-analysis process was used.
evidence.supports: note（這篇系統性回顧沒有做統合分析）

entries.note: 統合分析通常是系統性回顧的一部分。

evidence.location: Box 1 Glossary of terms, entry "Meta-analysis of effect estimates" (label dropped in PMC text; confirmed on bmj.com via WebFetch)

evidence.quote: We systematically reviewed the evidence for such an interaction and performed a meta-analysis to compare the efficacy of antimalarials among smoker versus nonsmoker patients with CLE.
evidence.supports: note（先系統性回顧，再做統合分析）

evidence.quote: Individual study odds ratios were combined in the meta-analysis using a random effects model.
Of 240 citations retrieved, 10 studies met inclusion criteria, for a total of 1398 patients.

Observational studies published up to March 2014 in the MEDLINE, Embase, and Cochrane databases were selected if they reported on the efficacy of antimalarials for treatment of CLE, according to smoking status.
The pooled odds ratio for the response to antimalarials in smoker patients with CLE (n = 797) was 0.53 (95% confidence interval 0.29-0.98) compared with nonsmokers (n = 601).
Smoking is associated with a 2-fold decrease in the proportion of patients with CLE achieving cutaneous improvement with antimalarials.

entries.confidence: High (PMC full text Tier 2 definition; site-cited meta-analysis abstract for the example)
entries.reviewer_notes: Example and SL-2.3 rely on Chasset 2015 (abstract only). It pooled observational studies, so its result is an association ("Smoking is associated with a 2-fold decrease ..."). The authors' "2-fold decrease" supports 「明顯」, but the pooled OR 0.53 has a wide 95% CI (0.29-0.98) whose upper bound is close to 1; the physician may keep or soften 「明顯」. entries.def: 隨機對照試驗是把參加者用隨機（類似抽籤）的方式分組，一組接受要測試的治療，另一組作為比較，再看兩組結果的差別。
entries.example: 例如ACR痛風指引提到的兩個維生素C小型試驗（29人和40人）。
entries.note: 隨機分組讓各組條件相近，是評估治療效果的標準方法；但人數少時結果較不精確。

evidence.quote: Participants should be assigned to comparison groups in the trial on the basis of a chance (random) process characterised by unpredictability
evidence.supports: def（以機率、無法預測的方式分組＝類似抽籤）

evidence.quote: Participants are then recruited and randomly assigned to either the intervention or the comparator group.

This is because the act of randomization balances participant characteristics (both observed and unobserved) between the groups allowing attribution of any differences in outcome to the study intervention.
evidence.supports: note（隨機分組讓各組條件相近）

evidence.quote: Randomised controlled trials, when appropriately designed, conducted, and reported, represent the gold standard in evaluating healthcare interventions.

entries.def: 觀察性研究是研究者不安排誰接受哪種治療或習慣，只記錄大家實際的情況，再分析這些情況和健康結果有沒有關聯。
entries.example: 例如比較吃櫻桃和沒吃櫻桃的期間，痛風發作的風險。
entries.note: 結果通常只能說明「有關聯」，因為無法排除其他因素的影響；證據確定性通常較低。

evidence.quote: Clinical research falls into two general categories: experimental and observational, based on whether the investigator assigns the exposures or not.

entries.def: 安慰劑是外觀像真的治療、但沒有真正療效的「假治療」（例如假藥丸、假針灸），研究中用來和真的治療比較。

entries.note: 拿到安慰劑的人有時也會覺得改善，所以真的治療要比安慰劑好，才算有效。

evidence.quote: In the context of research, a placebo is a substance or procedure which patients accept as a medicine or therapy, but which actually has no specific therapeutic activity for their conditions.
evidence.location: Table 3 (definition attributed to the World Health Organization, 2009)
evidence.supports: def（物質或程序；沒有特定療效）

evidence.quote: For operational purposes we defined placebo as “An inert substance usually prepared to look as similar to the active product investigated in a study as possible”
evidence.supports: def（做得和真的治療盡量相像）

evidence.quote: The reasons summarized above suggest that a misunderstanding of what a placebo is, and the reason for its use, may impede the participation of patients in studies that employ it as a comparison treatment.
evidence.supports: def（研究中當作比較用的治療）

evidence.quote: Meta-regression analyses showed that larger effects of placebo interventions were associated with physical placebo interventions (e.g. sham acupuncture)
There is low quality evidence that acupuncture is no different from placebo acupuncture with regard to dry mouth symptoms, which is the most important outcome.

Placebo and nocebo effects occur in clinical or laboratory medical contexts after administration of an inert treatment or as part of active treatments and are due to psychobiological mechanisms such as expectancies of the patient.
However, in certain settings placebo interventions can influence patient-reported outcomes, especially pain and nausea
evidence.supports: note（拿安慰劑也可能覺得改善）

entries.aka: certainty of evidence (also called quality of evidence; GRADE)
entries.def: 證據確定性是指我們對研究結果有多少把握：真正的效果和研究估計的是否接近。通常分為高、中、低、極低四級。

evidence.quote: GRADE specifies four categories-high, moderate, low, and very low-that are applied to a body of evidence, not to individual studies. In the context of a systematic review, quality reflects our confidence that the estimates of the effect are correct.
evidence.supports: def（四級；對效果估計正確的信心）

evidence.quote: Effect measures, such as risk ratios, were used to express the size of an effect, while the quality rating indicates the confidence that can be attributed to a result.

evidence.supports: def（真正效果可能和估計差很多）

found low quality evidence that acupuncture is no different from placebo

evidence.quote: Taiwan Rheumatology Association consensus recommendations for the management of axial spondyloarthritis.

Overarching principles and recommendations were established by consensus among a panel of rheumatology and rehabilitation experts, based on analysis of the most up-to-date clinical evidence and the clinical experience of panelists. All Overarching Principles and Recommendations were graded according to the standards developed by the Oxford Centre for Evidence Based Medicine, and further evaluated and modified using the Delphi method.
The Taiwan College of Rheumatology Consensus for the Management of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.

sources.short: 台灣 TRA 2020 中軸型脊椎關節炎共識
sources.citation: Wei JC, et al. Taiwan Rheumatology Association consensus recommendations for the management of axial spondyloarthritis. Int J Rheum Dis 2020;23(1):7-23.

sources.short: 台灣 TCR 2026 紅斑性狼瘡共識
sources.citation: Huang WN, et al. The Taiwan College of Rheumatology Consensus for the Management of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus. Int J Rheum Dis 2026;29(1):e70530.

entries.reviewer_notes: No Chinese official name is given: none was found in a PubMed source. Another PubMed-indexed Taiwanese consensus (Huang 2026, SLE) is titled "The Taiwan College of Rheumatology Consensus ..."; whether this is the same body as the Taiwan Rheumatology Association was not verified from PubMed, so the two names are not linked here.

entries.aka: American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (AAAAI); American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (ACAAI)
entries.def: 美國的兩個過敏、氣喘與免疫學會；代表它們的聯合工作小組，制定了2014年的蕁麻疹診療參數（指引）。
entries.label: AAAAI/ACAAI 2014・名稱

evidence.quote: These parameters were developed by the Joint Task Force on Practice Parameters (JTFPP), representing the American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (AAAAI); the American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (ACAAI); and the Joint Council of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology.

sources.short: AAAAI/ACAAI 2014 美國蕁麻疹診療參數
sources.citation: Bernstein JA, et al. The diagnosis and management of acute and chronic urticaria: 2014 update. J Allergy Clin Immunol 2014;133(5):1270-7.

entries.reviewer_notes: The Joint Task Force on Practice Parameters also represents a third body, the Joint Council of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (Bernstein 2014 abstract); the gloss mentions only the two named on the site. The 2026 urticaria guideline lists delegates of "The American College of Allergy, Asthma and Immunology" (spelled with "and"); the Bernstein 2014 spelling with "&" is used in aka.

was supported by the British Society for Allergy & Clinical Immunology (BSACI)

entries.label: ECTS 2024・名稱

evidence.quote: Prevention and treatment of glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis in adults: recommendations from the European Calcified Tissue Society.
This report presents the recommendations of the European Calcified Tissue Society (ECTS) for the prevention and treatment of glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis (GIOP) in adults.

sources.short: ECTS 2024 類固醇骨質疏鬆建議
sources.citation: Paccou J, et al. Prevention and treatment of glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis in adults: recommendations from the European Calcified Tissue Society. Eur J Endocrinol 2024;191(6):G1-G17.

entries.reviewer_notes: No PubMed source describing the society itself was found; the gloss stays literal (鈣化組織學會) and describes it only by its published osteoporosis recommendations. 「鈣化組織」 is not explained further because no quote defines it.

entries.aka: Sjögren's Foundation (in 2016–2017 publications: Sjögren's Syndrome Foundation)
entries.def: 美國的乾燥症基金會；發表過乾燥症口腔、眼睛、風濕（全身）表現及肺部的照護指引。

sources.short: 2016 乾燥症基金會治療指引綜述
sources.citation: Vivino FB, et al. New Treatment Guidelines for Sjögren's Disease. Rheum Dis Clin North Am 2016;42(3):531-51.

sources.citation: Carsons SE, et al. Treatment Guidelines for Rheumatologic Manifestations of Sjögren's Syndrome: Use of Biologic Agents, Management of Fatigue, and Inflammatory Musculoskeletal Pain. Arthritis Care Res (Hoboken) 2017;69(4):517-527.

entries.reviewer_notes: The site label 'Sjögren's Foundation 2016' refers to Zero 2016 (JADA); that abstract does not name the Foundation, but Vivino 2016 states that the Sjögren's Syndrome Foundation developed the oral, ocular and rheumatologic guidelines. No PubMed source explicitly stating the renaming was found; both names are reported as printed. Lee 2021 PMC text uses a typographic apostrophe (Sjögren’s); the PubMed abstract quoted here uses a straight one.
